A bold wrapper holding only a newline-only span still separates the words on either side

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<b>Alpha</b><b><span>\n</span></b><b>Beta</b>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
